answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 12500 Country: India Title: Mufti sahab Asslam Alekum, Mufti Sahab Main apne 1 motabar mufit se poocha tha ki hum log kaun kaun si miswak kar sakate hai, to unhone sirf ye batayaa ki jo kadawi ho, jisme resaa daat me na lage, jaharili miswak haram hai, matalab vo kisi kitab ko pad ke bataa rahe the, kya aap mujhe kam se kam 8-10 tree(ped) ke naam bataa sakate hai jiski miswak jayaz hai, mufti sagab mujhe darakht ka naam chahiye jaise Neem,Peelu,Jaitun etc. Question: Mufti sahab Asslam Alekum, Mufti Sahab Main apne 1 motabar mufit se poocha tha ki hum log kaun kaun si miswak kar sakate hai, to unhone sirf ye batayaa ki jo kadawi ho, jisme resaa daat me na lage, jaharili miswak haram hai, matalab vo kisi kitab ko pad ke bataa rahe the, kya aap mujhe kam se kam 8-10 tree(ped) ke naam bataa sakate hai jiski miswak jayaz hai, mufti sagab mujhe darakht ka naam chahiye jaise Neem,Peelu,Jaitun etc. Answer ID: 12500 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 760/719=B/1430) Doing miswak with stick of any tree or plant except bamboo plants and pomegranate is permissible: ویصح بکل عود إ لا الرمان والقصب لمضرتھما (حاشیۃ الطحطاوی علی مراقی الفلاح 67) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
